name: CloudSigma
tagline: Swiss cloud IaaS with fully customizable CPU, RAM and storage
description: CloudSigma is a Swiss/European cloud IaaS provider letting you size CPU, RAM and storage independently, billed by the resource rather than in bundled VM tiers.
about: CloudSigma is a European cloud infrastructure provider, headquartered in Switzerland, built around a pure infrastructure-as-a-service model rather than fixed shared-hosting plans. Instead of picking from pre-bundled VM sizes, customers configure CPU core count, RAM and SSD storage independently for each server, then pay only for what they provision — a model aimed at developers and businesses with specific, variable infrastructure needs rather than beginners wanting a one-click website.

Pricing runs on a per-resource, utility-style model: CPU, RAM, storage and bandwidth are each billed separately, either as a prepaid subscription or as pay-as-you-go burst usage charged in short billing cycles. Published plan pricing spans roughly $14 to $677 per month depending on configuration, with discounts reported around 10% for annual commitments and larger discounts for multi-year terms. Servers are available across a wide network of data center locations spanning Europe, North America and Asia.

There is no bundled control panel like cPanel or hPanel included by default — management happens through CloudSigma's own web console and API, which suits developers comfortable provisioning and configuring servers directly but adds a learning curve for anyone expecting a beginner-friendly dashboard or one-click app installer.
policies: CloudSigma has offered a free trial period (around 7 days in public reviews) to test the platform before committing to paid usage; confirm current trial terms directly on CloudSigma's site, as trial length and eligibility can change.

Because billing is usage-based and resource-separated, refund terms depend on whether charges are subscription or burst-based — check CloudSigma's own billing and cancellation policy before assuming a fixed money-back window applies.
